description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Save an immutable, org and brand scoped snapshot for selected ad accounts and an inclusive 1–30 day window. Reads vendors only; no charge, analysis, ad writes or spend. Each source reports availability.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/snapshots.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand. A brand-bound key is always pinned to its brand; any other value is 403.

name: ads_snapshot_collect
title: Collect ads data snapshot
